#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <climits>
#include <complex>
#include <algorithm>
#include <tuple>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

using llong = long long;
using ldouble = long double;
using pt = complex<llong>;

template<typename F, typename C>
class MinCostFlow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int from, to;
        F capacity, flow;
        C weight;
        int reverse_index;
    };

    int vertex_count;
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<C> distance, potential;
    vector<Edge*> parent_edge;

    MinCostFlow(int n) : vertex_count(n), graph(n), distance(n), potential(n), parent_edge(n) {}

    void connect(int u, int v, F cap, C cost) {
        graph[u].push_back({u, v, cap, 0, cost, (int)graph[v].size()});
        if (u == v) graph[u].back().reverse_index++;
        graph[v].push_back({v, u, 0, 0, -cost, (int)graph[u].size() - 1});
    }

    const C INF = numeric_limits<C>::max();

    bool shortest_path(int source, int sink) {
        fill(distance.begin(), distance.end(), INF);
        fill(parent_edge.begin(), parent_edge.end(), nullptr);
        distance[source] = 0;

        using pii = pair<C, int>;
        priority_queue<pii, vector<pii>, greater<pii>> pq;
        pq.emplace(0, source);

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [d, u] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (d != distance[u]) continue;

            for (auto &e : graph[u]) {
                if (e.flow < e.capacity &&
                    distance[e.to] > distance[u] + e.weight + potential[u] - potential[e.to]) {
                    distance[e.to] = distance[u] + e.weight + potential[u] - potential[e.to];
                    parent_edge[e.to] = &e;
                    pq.emplace(distance[e.to], e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return distance[sink] < INF;
    }

    pair<F, C> compute(int s, int t) {
        F total_flow = 0;
        C total_cost = 0;

        fill(potential.begin(), potential.end(), 0);
        while (shortest_path(s, t)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < vertex_count; ++i) {
                if (distance[i] < INF) {
                    potential[i] += distance[i];
                }
            }

            F delta = numeric_limits<F>::max();
            for (Edge *e = parent_edge[t]; e; e = parent_edge[e->from]) {
                delta = min(delta, e->capacity - e->flow);
            }

            for (Edge *e = parent_edge[t]; e; e = parent_edge[e->from]) {
                e->flow += delta;
                graph[e->to][e->reverse_index].flow -= delta;
                total_cost += delta * e->weight;
            }
            total_flow += delta;
        }

        return make_pair(total_flow, total_cost);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    vector<int> markers(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0, x; i < k; ++i) {
        cin >> x;
        ++markers[x];
    }

    // We'll use time-expanded network approach
    // Let's limit the maximum time to k*n (upper bound on time needed)
    int max_time = k * n + 1;
    int nodes_per_time = n + 1; // crossroads 1..n plus a sink node
    int total_nodes = (max_time + 1) * (n + 1);
    int sink_node = total_nodes - 1;

    MinCostFlow<int, long long> solver(total_nodes);

    // Connect source to starting positions at time 0
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (markers[i] > 0) {
            solver.connect(0, i, markers[i], 0);
        }
    }

    // Connect edges between time layers
    for (int t = 0; t < max_time; ++t) {
        // Wait edges: stay at same crossroad
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            solver.connect(t * (n + 1) + i, (t + 1) * (n + 1) + i, k, c);
        }

        // Walk edges: move along existing streets
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            int u, v;
            cin >> u >> v;
            // For each possible number of people walking together (1 to k)
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j) {
                // Cost for j people walking together: d*j*j + c (c for arrival cost)
                // But we need to model this properly - we'll use multiple edges
                solver.connect(t * (n + 1) + u, (t + 1) * (n + 1) + v, 1, (llong)d * j * j + c);
                solver.connect(t * (n + 1) + v, (t + 1) * (n + 1) + u, 1, (llong)d * j * j + c);
            }
        }
    }

    // Connect all arrivals at crossroad 1 to sink
    for (int t = 0; t <= max_time; ++t) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
            solver.connect(t * (n + 1) + 1, sink_node, 1, 0);
        }
    }

    auto result = solver.compute(0, sink_node);
    cout << result.second << '\n';

    return 0;
}
